comment: Pinned external data files. URLs point to immutable refs (commit SHA / versioned release). SHA256 computed at first download (2026-06-11) and verified on every run of scripts/download_data.py. No other network access exists in this project.

files.name: desi_gaussian_bao_ALL_GCcomb_mean.txt
files.description: DESI DR2 BAO measurements, all tracers (13 points). CobayaSampler/bao_data at commit b7b8a36 (= tag v2.6, sole commit touching desi_bao_dr2/).

files.name: desi_gaussian_bao_ALL_GCcomb_cov.txt
files.description: 13x13 covariance for the DESI DR2 BAO measurements (block-diagonal per tracer). Same pinned commit as the mean file.

files.name: desi_dr2_cmb_compressed_prior.yaml
files.description: Official DESI DR2 cobaya chain config (base_w_wa, desi-bao-all + compressed CMB prior). Source of the full-precision (thetastar, ombh2, ombch2) means and covariance matching arXiv:2503.14738v3 Eqs. (35)-(36).

files.name: Pantheon+SH0ES.dat
files.description: Pantheon+ distances (1701 rows, 47 named columns). PantheonPlusSH0ES/DataRelease at commit c447f0f (HEAD 2022-12-21, repo unchanged since).

files.name: Pantheon+SH0ES_STAT+SYS.cov
files.description: Pantheon+ full STAT+SYS covariance (first line = 1701, then N^2 values one per line). Same pinned commit as the .dat file.

files.name: DES-SN5YR_HD.csv
files.description: DES-SN5YR Hubble diagram, 1829 SNe (CID, IDSURVEY, zHD, zHEL, MU, MUERR_FINAL, ...). des-science/DES-SN5YR pinned at tag v1.2 commit 95cf14c (2024 paper state; main moved to Dovekie).

files.name: DES-SN5YR_STAT+SYS.txt.gz
files.description: DES-SN5YR systematic covariance (first line = 1829, then N^2 values one per line, gzip). Total covariance = this + diag(MUERR_FINAL^2). Tag v1.2.

files.name: DES-SN5YR_fw0wacdm_SN.txt
files.description: Official DES-SN5YR flat w0waCDM SN-only polychord chain (weighted; header embeds the exact priors: omega_m U[0.01,0.99], h0 U[0.3,1], w U[-5,1], wa U[-20,10], m U[-1,1]). Anchor for gate G3.3. Tag v1.2.

files.name: DES-SN5YR_flcdm_SN.txt
files.description: Official DES-SN5YR flat LCDM SN-only polychord chain (weighted). Context check for gate G3.2. Tag v1.2.

files.name: DES-SN5YR_SN_only_cosmosis_likelihood.py
files.description: Official DES-SN5YR SN-only likelihood (convention reference only, never imported): chi2 = a - b^2/c + ln(c/2pi) [Goliath et al. astro-ph/0104009 Eqs. A9-A12], mu_th = 5 log10((1+zHD)(1+zHEL) D_A) + 25. Tag v1.2.

files.name: Union3_lcparam_full.txt
files.description: Union3 binned distances (22 spline nodes, z = 0.05 to 2.26226, mb = distance modulus with arbitrary zero point). CobayaSampler/sn_data at commit 61d9643 (files used by cobaya sn.union3, i.e. by DESI).

files.name: Union3_mag_covmat.txt
files.description: Union3 22x22 magnitude covariance. Same pinned commit as lcparam_full.txt.

files.name: desi_dr2_base_cmbcompressed_chain.1.txt
files.description: Official DESI DR2 LCDM chain, desi-bao-all + compressed CMB prior (G5.2 audit anchor; per-point chi2__BAO, chi2__CMB_compressed, rdrag columns).

files.name: desi_dr2_base_cmbcompressed_chain.2.txt
files.description: Official DESI DR2 LCDM chain (2/4), same combination.

files.name: desi_dr2_base_cmbcompressed_chain.3.txt
files.description: Official DESI DR2 LCDM chain (3/4), same combination.

files.name: desi_dr2_base_cmbcompressed_chain.4.txt
files.description: Official DESI DR2 LCDM chain (4/4), same combination.

files.name: desi_dr2_base_cmbcompressed_chain.margestats
files.description: Marginalized statistics of the official LCDM compressed-prior chain.

files.name: desi_dr2_base_w_wa_cmbcompressed_chain.1.txt
files.description: Official DESI DR2 w0waCDM chain, desi-bao-all + compressed CMB prior (G5.2 audit anchor).

files.name: desi_dr2_base_w_wa_cmbcompressed_chain.2.txt
files.description: Official DESI DR2 w0waCDM chain (2/4), same combination.

files.name: desi_dr2_base_w_wa_cmbcompressed_chain.3.txt
files.description: Official DESI DR2 w0waCDM chain (3/4), same combination.

files.name: desi_dr2_base_w_wa_cmbcompressed_chain.4.txt
files.description: Official DESI DR2 w0waCDM chain (4/4), same combination.

files.name: desi_dr2_base_w_wa_cmbcompressed_chain.margestats
files.description: Marginalized statistics of the official w0waCDM compressed-prior chain (H0 63.7, w -0.43+/-0.22, wa -1.72+/-0.64, rdrag 147.34+/-0.23).

files.name: DES-Dovekie_HD.csv
files.description: DES-Dovekie recalibrated Hubble diagram (V5, P13). SNANA space-delimited, 1820 SNe, VARNAMES: CID IDSURVEY zHD zHEL MU MUERR MUERR_VPEC MUERR_SYS PROBIA_BEAMS (MUERR_FINAL removed vs v1.2). des-science/DES-SN5YR pinned at main HEAD commit c9a4fcaf (2026-01-28, Dovekie/Popovic et al. 2026 state; main no longer carries the v1.2 files).

files.name: DES-Dovekie_STAT+SYS.npz
files.description: DES-Dovekie total stat+sys covariance, stored as its INVERSE (Covtot_inv) in numpy npz (keys nsn, cov; cov float32 upper-triangular incl. diagonal, length 1820*1821/2). Total covariance C = inv(inv_cov); NO diag(MUERR^2) is added (unlike v1.2). Same pinned commit c9a4fcaf.

files.name: DES-Dovekie-SN_Likelihood.py
files.description: Official DES-Dovekie SN likelihood (convention reference only, never imported): offset-marginalized Gaussian chi2 = a - b^2/c + ln(c/2pi) [Goliath et al. astro-ph/0104009 A9-A12], NO per-SN BEAMS weighting (coherence gate H, P13.7); mu_th = 5 log10((1+zHD)(1+zHEL) D_A) + 25. Same pinned commit c9a4fcaf.
